sources.name: Manitou Springs Chamber of Commerce, Visitors Bureau & Office of Economic Development (Visit Manitou Springs)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. Home page (phone 719-685-5089, no street address, a 2026 business map, 'Manitou Incline: Open | Reservations Required'), the Signature Events page (annual events with 2026 dates through the 26 September Heritage Brew Festival; the coffin races given only as 'the Saturday before Halloween') and the coffin races page (Saturday, October 24, 2026: fan zone 10 am in the 700 block, parade noon, races about 1-2 pm in the 900 block, after-party 2-5 pm at Soda Springs Park, free), which the published event cites. The Events Calendar page is a PeakRadar embed (peakradar.com event links, 'durations approximate', page 1 of 2 shown), i.e. an aggregator: it listed the Manitou 5K, Field Day at Soda Springs Park, Haunted Manitou tours, Green Horse Gallery and Commonwheel shows and a Pikes Peak RV Park harvest festival, none of which were published from it. Use the calendar as a lead list only; publish from each organizer's own page. No feed found.

sources.name: Pikes Peak Library District, Manitou Springs Library
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. The branch page gives 701 Manitou Ave., (719) 531-6333 x7004, Mon-Thu 10 am-6 pm, Fri-Sat 9 am-5 pm, closed Sunday; the published listing cites it. ppld.org/events?branch=manitou-springs-library rendered the filter controls but no listings to an automated reader (a 'Load More' script), so no library events were published; the district's calendar may offer a branch-filtered feed worth confirming by hand.

sources.name: USDA Forest Service, Pike and San Isabel National Forests (Pikes Peak Ranger District)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. The alerts page answered 200 and lists Pikes Peak Ranger District orders with start dates only: Waldo Canyon burn area closure (9 July 2024), South Catamount dam repair (30 October 2023), Crags winter area and Rampart Range Road 300 winter closures (1 December 2022), Bear Creek watershed restrictions (9 September 2022), forest-wide occupancy, lake, food-storage and camping orders. Nothing names the Manitou Incline or Barr Trail. A guessed page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/barr-trail returned 404, so no Barr Trail or Incline listing was made; find the district's Barr Trail page by hand. Linked from the town config's conditions links.

sources.name: Manitou Springs Heritage Center (Heritage Museum)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. Home page (517 Manitou Avenue, (719) 685-1454, 'Open every day Noon-4:00pm or by appointment'), the events calendar (The Events Calendar plugin, October 2026: five Ghost Stories of Old Manitou walking-tour nights 5:30-8:30 pm, Cool Science Festival talks on 10 October, three Sunday Night Frights watch parties, the coffin races listed 10 am-5 pm at Soda Springs Park) and the ghost tours page (annual fundraiser since 1995, Eventbrite tickets, no price). The place, the walking tours and the watch parties cite these. A The Events Calendar site usually serves /events/?ical=1; not tested, confirm by hand before setting a feedUrl.

sources.name: Garden of the Gods Visitor & Nature Center (City of Colorado Springs park)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. Home page (1805 N. 30th Street, 719-634-6666; park 5 am-10 pm 1 May-31 Oct and 5 am-9 pm 1 Nov-30 Apr; center 9-5 winter, 9-6 Memorial Day weekend-Labor Day weekend, closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day; free; a public-private partnership with the City of Colorado Springs parks department and the Garden of the Gods Foundation; an October 2026 program calendar) and the directions page (visitor-center lot under 200 spaces, overflow lot off Gateway Road, shuttle, oversized vehicles). The park listing and the Trunk or Treat event cite these. In Colorado Springs, not Manitou; listed as the park on Manitou's doorstep.

sources.name: manitouincline.com (fan site, not the land manager)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. A fan-run site ('Powered by Socrates', credits Incline Friends): says the Incline is open with reservations required, links a reopening post and trailhead directions, sells a 2026 calendar; names no operator, hours, parking or length. Not an official source, so no Incline listing was made. The City of Manitou Springs page is blocked (403); a guessed https://coloradosprings.gov/manitou-incline returned 404; the Chamber's /manitou-incline/ path answered 301 to manitousprings.org/manitou-incline/ and was not read. Find the official reservation page by hand.
